style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the step is wooden beads and the flags are pale cloth on wood: keys in the wood's own warm tan, Enter a berry or grape treat of the same bright world; derived from the bead.

images.why: Stage: 'The step block ... holding the chosen number as that many countable things so the step has a size and not only a name.' Counters/beads are the table's 'n of them' object; one bead drawn N times by the tool.
images.prompt: One round light wooden bead with a small round hole through its centre, warm honey-tan wood with a soft grain and a gentle satin sheen.

images.object: cloth pennant flag on a wooden stick
images.why: Description/Look/Stage: 'a flag on every step', 'a numbered flag 48 by 72 planted where it lands'. One blank flag drawn once per landing; the number and the content colour are drawn in code over the cloth.
images.prompt: A small flag with a large, broad, almost square, plain smooth blank pale butter-yellow cloth that fills the upper two thirds of the picture and nearly its whole width, fixed along its left edge to a slim light wooden stick that runs straight up and down, reaching only a little above the cloth and a good way below it.
